items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: they'd go back and do another demo in the style of Jimmy Clinton. I mean, they'd come back with some kid singing on it. It was obviously an imitation, you know?

ctx.x: Would you believe $10,000? I don't know what they're paying. Yeah. But, yeah.

Or, and sometimes it was, one of the things you could get done, for instance, from the good publishers, not just the major publishers, the good publishers, is they would do a demo in your artist's style. It was something I tried to say at that meeting that day, about targeting your song. If you're going to do a demo, do it in the style of the person you're pitching it to, you know? And, but they would do that. They'd go back and do another demo in the style of Jimmy Clinton. I mean, they'd come back with some kid…
